speech:
Alright, Grizzly Rips, pull up a chair, because this one's going to sting a little. Today was a D. 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss, 2 goals scored, 4 conceded. Our team rating sat at 6.81 when our usual is 7.9. We came in off an A-minus and played like folks who'd misplaced their cleats in the parking lot.

And let's talk about that last match. Goal Scorer 18 beat us 0-3, and two of y'all walked out the door before the final whistle. Two rage quits in one match. That's not losing, that's leaving. A ship doesn't sink because of the storm. It sinks because the crew jumps overboard.

Ladder-wise, we started the day in Division 2 with 11 of 16 points and 2 of 3 chances left. We finish it with 15 of 16 and 1 chance left. We're one single point from Division 1, and we're walking that tightrope with no net.

buddskees, you scored both our goals and took Man of the Match twice. You were our heartbeat early with an 8.6 against Sacks N Racks. But you averaged 7.4 when you're usually an 8.2. You went 0 for 8 in tackles. And in that 0-3 you attempted just 6 passes, down from your usual 28. That's not a forward going quiet, that's a forward going missing. Your 6.0 to finish the day was a lightbulb flickering out.

PhogsToffees, you quit on us against Goal Scorer 18, and I need you to hear me say that plainly. You averaged 6.7 against a usual 8.6. You passed at 65%, 36 of 55, when you live at 78%. And 0 for 8 in tackles. Now, credit where it's due: 2 assists, 3 key passes against Wetter FC, and 20 completed passes in that match, more than any of their humans managed. You've got the vision. Don't let frustration fog up the windshield.

BellyTb1, you rage quit that same match. You averaged 5.6 against a usual 8.6, and that's a cliff, not a dip. You completed just 5 passes against Sacks N Racks, down from your usual 21. And 5 shots on the day, 0 on target. Zero. You did lead us with 2 shots in that opening win and cut your misplaced passes to 3 from your usual 7, so the care is in there somewhere.

Which brings me to our real problem: shot selection. Tight angles and long range are where shots go to die. Work it into the middle of the box before you pull the trigger. If you've got a half second, set your feet. If the angle's tight, cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot every single time.

Now, here's the thing. My grandma used to say a rough Sunday just means the pie's still in the oven. We are 24 wins into this season. We have put 129 goals in the net. And we are one point, just one, from Division 1. That's not a team in trouble. That's a team standing at the front door with the key in its hand.

So stay in the match, stay with each other, and next time out, we turn that key together. I believe in y'all. Now let's go get that point.
